   # declaration's parameter/return types. So we parse the rest, then rewrite it (the
   # plain whole-type-name form; parametric `Vec(Name)` substitution is the tail).
   pub def parse_program([TKw("alias"), TId(name), TOp(":="), TId(base) | rest]) := subst_in(name, base, parse_program(rest))
+  # `macro name(p, …) := body` — a term-rewriting macro. Rian.Decl CONSUMES it (no
+  # output node) and EXPANDS every later `name(args)` call site to `body` with the
+  # parameters substituted by the arguments. Parse the param names + body expression,
+  # then expand it through the rest.
+  pub def parse_program([TKw("macro"), TId(name), TLP | rest])
+    case parse_typelist(rest) do
+      TL(params, [TOp(":=") | body]) ->
+        case parse_bp(0, skip_nl(body)) do
+          P(b, rest2) -> expand_in(Mac(name, params, b), parse_program(rest2))
+        end
+      TL(_, other) -> parse_program(other)
+    end
+  end
   pub def parse_program([TKw("struct") | rest])
     case parse_struct(rest) do
       DR(d, rest2) -> [d | parse_program(rest2)]
@@ -208,6 +221,96 @@ mod SelfhostDecl do
 
   def subst_ty(name String, base String, ty String) String := if ty == name do base else ty end
 
+  # ── macro expansion ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+  # A macro carries its name, parameter names, and body template; `Subst` is one
+  # param->argument binding for instantiating the template at a call site.
+  type Macro := Mac(String, Vec(String), Expr)
+  type Subst := SB(String, Expr)
+
+  # walk every later declaration's function body, rewriting `name(args)` call sites
+  # to the template body with the parameters substituted (the arguments are first
+  # themselves expanded, so nested macro calls resolve).
+  def expand_in(m Macro, decls Vec(Decl)) Vec(Decl)
+  def expand_in(_, []) := []
+  def expand_in(m, [d | rest]) := [expand_decl(m, d) | expand_in(m, rest)]
+
+  def expand_decl(m Macro, d Decl) Decl
+  def expand_decl(m, DFunc(pb, fn, ps, ret, tvs, body)) := DFunc(pb, fn, ps, ret, tvs, expand_e(m, body))
+  def expand_decl(_, d) := d
+
+  def expand_e(m Macro, e Expr) Expr
+  def expand_e(Mac(mn, mp, mt), Call(Id(f), args))
+    eargs := expand_es(Mac(mn, mp, mt), args)
+    if f == mn do
+      subst_e(zip_env(mp, eargs), mt)
+    else
+      Call(Id(f), eargs)
+    end
+  end
+  def expand_e(m, Call(callee, args)) := Call(expand_e(m, callee), expand_es(m, args))
+  def expand_e(m, Bin(op, l, r)) := Bin(op, expand_e(m, l), expand_e(m, r))
+  def expand_e(m, Unary(op, x)) := Unary(op, expand_e(m, x))
+  def expand_e(m, Dot(e, fld)) := Dot(expand_e(m, e), fld)
+  def expand_e(m, Label(l, v)) := Label(l, expand_e(m, v))
+  def expand_e(m, If(c, t, el)) := If(expand_e(m, c), expand_e(m, t), expand_e(m, el))
+  def expand_e(m, Case(s, arms)) := Case(expand_e(m, s), expand_arms(m, arms))
+  def expand_e(m, BlockE(stmts)) := BlockE(expand_stmts(m, stmts))
+  def expand_e(m, Tuple(es)) := Tuple(expand_es(m, es))
+  def expand_e(m, ConsE(h, t)) := ConsE(expand_e(m, h), expand_e(m, t))
+  def expand_e(_, e) := e
+
+  def expand_es(m Macro, es Vec(Expr)) Vec(Expr)
+  def expand_es(_, []) := []
+  def expand_es(m, [e | rest]) := [expand_e(m, e) | expand_es(m, rest)]
+
+  def expand_arms(m Macro, arms Vec(CaseArm)) Vec(CaseArm)
+  def expand_arms(_, []) := []
+  def expand_arms(m, [CArm(p, b) | rest]) := [CArm(p, expand_e(m, b)) | expand_arms(m, rest)]
+  def expand_arms(m, [CArmG(p, g, b) | rest]) := [CArmG(p, expand_e(m, g), expand_e(m, b)) | expand_arms(m, rest)]
+
+  def expand_stmts(m Macro, ss Vec(Stmt)) Vec(Stmt)
+  def expand_stmts(_, []) := []
+  def expand_stmts(m, [SBind(n, e) | rest]) := [SBind(n, expand_e(m, e)) | expand_stmts(m, rest)]
+  def expand_stmts(m, [SExpr(e) | rest]) := [SExpr(expand_e(m, e)) | expand_stmts(m, rest)]
+
+  # instantiate the template: substitute each `Id(param)` by its bound argument.
+  def zip_env(ps Vec(String), args Vec(Expr)) Vec(Subst)
+  def zip_env([], _) := []
+  def zip_env(_, []) := []
+  def zip_env([p | ps], [a | as]) := [SB(p, a) | zip_env(ps, as)]
+
+  def lookup_subst(env Vec(Subst), name String) Expr
+  def lookup_subst([], name) := Id(name)
+  def lookup_subst([SB(p, a) | rest], name) := if p == name do a else lookup_subst(rest, name) end
+
+  def subst_e(env Vec(Subst), e Expr) Expr
+  def subst_e(env, Id(name)) := lookup_subst(env, name)
+  def subst_e(env, Bin(op, l, r)) := Bin(op, subst_e(env, l), subst_e(env, r))
+  def subst_e(env, Unary(op, x)) := Unary(op, subst_e(env, x))
+  def subst_e(env, Call(c, args)) := Call(subst_e(env, c), subst_es(env, args))
+  def subst_e(env, Dot(e, fld)) := Dot(subst_e(env, e), fld)
+  def subst_e(env, Label(l, v)) := Label(l, subst_e(env, v))
+  def subst_e(env, If(c, t, el)) := If(subst_e(env, c), subst_e(env, t), subst_e(env, el))
+  def subst_e(env, Case(s, arms)) := Case(subst_e(env, s), subst_arms(env, arms))
+  def subst_e(env, BlockE(stmts)) := BlockE(subst_stmts(env, stmts))
+  def subst_e(env, Tuple(es)) := Tuple(subst_es(env, es))
+  def subst_e(env, ConsE(h, t)) := ConsE(subst_e(env, h), subst_e(env, t))
+  def subst_e(_, e) := e
+
+  def subst_es(env Vec(Subst), es Vec(Expr)) Vec(Expr)
+  def subst_es(_, []) := []
+  def subst_es(env, [e | rest]) := [subst_e(env, e) | subst_es(env, rest)]
+
+  def subst_arms(env Vec(Subst), arms Vec(CaseArm)) Vec(CaseArm)
+  def subst_arms(_, []) := []
+  def subst_arms(env, [CArm(p, b) | rest]) := [CArm(p, subst_e(env, b)) | subst_arms(env, rest)]
+  def subst_arms(env, [CArmG(p, g, b) | rest]) := [CArmG(p, subst_e(env, g), subst_e(env, b)) | subst_arms(env, rest)]
+
+  def subst_stmts(env Vec(Subst), ss Vec(Stmt)) Vec(Stmt)
+  def subst_stmts(_, []) := []
+  def subst_stmts(env, [SBind(n, e) | rest]) := [SBind(n, subst_e(env, e)) | subst_stmts(env, rest)]
+  def subst_stmts(env, [SExpr(e) | rest]) := [SExpr(subst_e(env, e)) | subst_stmts(env, rest)]
+
   # parse a standalone EXPRESSION from a token list (the driver uses this to inline
   # an `@external(:ex, "host expr")` body, ADR-0068). Trailing tokens are ignored.
   pub def parse_expr(ts Vec(Tok)) Expr
